question: Among A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H, H is the father of G, G is the only brother of F, F is the only sister-in-law of E, E is the mother of D, D is the brother of C and B is the father of H and husband of A. If F is unmarried, then how is D related to A?
solution:
The symbol of the family tree is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99fa0d00b4d4569c1c4104735d602ab8fea9e061792519ec5ff36a5c53c88559.png] 

According to the given information, the family tree will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81bef1dbbfba2545ad2cd13a730088345322b9ebdf6b962a841ef026f30951c2.png] 

 

Thus, D is '**Son's Son's Son**' of A.

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 1**__'.
